title: Task group (F153-FR-054 to -056; data-model.md D9)
description: One task group of a phase, sliced at derivation by the pure table core/src/spec-groups/slicer.ts and frozen, with its hash, in the launch contract under configuration (CQ-153-07 answered A on 2026-11-13).

groupId.description: The id of the group, `phase<N>-g<M>`, M counting from 1 in task order.

taskIds.description: The ordered task ids of the group; a task is never split and the groups follow task order (CQ-153-15 A).

acceptanceCheck.description: The declared acceptance check of fixed argv (F105-FR-015), or the record `unchecked` — never rejected, never passed (F153-FR-055).

dependsOn.description: F154-FR-032 (feature 154, phase 9, T075; CQ-154-02, -09) — OPTIONAL. The group ids this group declares a dependency on, frozen at derivation into the per-group records of `specstride.task-groups-frozen/1` (the `configuration.taskGroups` block of the launch contract, `pipeline/src/contract/commands/derive.ts`, `taskGroupDeclarations`). A group with no declaration carries neither this field nor `independentWith`, exactly as feature 153 froze it; the frozen record's schema id is unchanged.

independentWith.description: F154-FR-032 (T075) — OPTIONAL. The group ids this group declares independence with; read at run time by the independence decision (`layer-parallel/src/independence.ts`) and overriding the PG-1 marker rule (PG-3), never the pairwise scope disjointness of F142-FR-009 (closed-set-deltas.md row 21).
